summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the redemption of its outstanding $500M 6.75% Callable Fixed Rate Reset Additional Tier 1 Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities. The entire principal, plus accrued interest, will be redeemed on June 27, 2026 at par (100%). The redemption is a routine capital management action to retire high-cost AT1 perpetuals, removing the contingent conversion feature. Listing on the Irish Stock Exchange will be cancelled post-redemption. No board recommendation or advisor is noted. This is a straightforward liability management event reducing future interest obligations. Watch for the irrevocable deposit of funds and potential replacement issuance.
